sections.heading: Reading the numbers
sections.body:
Revenue alone favors the broad launch, but the spread on risk-adjusted value is under 3% between broad launch and phased rollout once support, remediation, and expected risk cost are charged. That closeness is the story: the quantitative model does not decide this on its own, which is precisely why the qualitative risk register matters.

Every figure is recomputed by compute-scenarios.mjs in this run folder — rerun it to check the math. Scenario ACVs are corpus evidence about enterprise contracts, not Ledgerly catalog prices; the catalog is unchanged.
